creativeThesis: One engineer crosses two devastated cities, then carries his witness into later life; consequential changes in space, state and life stage drive the film.
viewerExperience: An intimate person becomes an engineer at work, is displaced into a damaged city, travels visibly across dated geography, faces a second interruption, survives with lasting consequences, and becomes an advocate.
emotionalTarget: Astonishment settles into understanding, empathy and remembrance.
